description: True-to-original 33 metre reconstruction of the passenger section of the airship LZ 129 Hindenburg, walk-through, with the Bauhaus promenade deck, cabins and washrooms. This is a reconstruction, not original airship structure; the largest surviving original wreck part of LZ 129, the rudder bearing arm, is displayed inside it.
Original structural fragment of LZ 129 Hindenburg: the rudder bearing arm, the largest surviving wreck part of the airship destroyed at Lakehurst in 1937.
